coverage.main: Read all 22 pages of arXiv 1802.08195v3 (22 May 2018; NeurIPS 2018): Sections 1-6, Figures 1-5, references and supplemental Appendices A-F (Tables Supp.1-6, retinal layer, coarse-class probability, attack details, models, image lists).
coverage.supplement: The arXiv appendix omits example images and links http://goo.gl/SJ8jpq, which resolves to a Google Drive file; downloaded the fourteen-page full supplemental PDF. Its tables (e.g., Supp.4 8.7, 9.4, 13 and Supp.6 87, 85, 57) match arXiv; it adds Figures Supp.2-5 example images.
coverage.excluded_results: Tables Supp.3 and Supp.5 evaluate the ten ensemble members used to generate the attack (white-box for the source ensemble). Figure Supp.1 and Figure 5 are qualitative. Figure 4 reaction times are secondary behavioural measures of the human group, not separate transfer rates.

result_groups.locator: Section 4.1 (p. 6); Tables Supp.4 and Supp.6 (pp. 15-16); Appendix D (p. 17)
result_groups.population: Retained targeted coarse-class adversarial images per group (pets, hazard, vegetables) generated on a 10-model retina-layer ensemble; held-out ResNet V2 50 and adversarially trained Inception V3
result_groups.outcome: held-out model accuracy and coarse-class attack success
result_groups.evidence: Appendix D: 'we retained only adversarial examples that were successful against all 10 models for the adv condition and at least 7/10 models for the false condition', an explicit source-success restriction of the transferred set. No target-clean filter on the held-out models is stated.

result_groups.population: 38 time-limited human subjects (140-950 trials each) viewing the same retained images in image, adv, flip and false conditions
result_groups.outcome: human two-alternative accuracy and probability of choosing the targeted class
result_groups.evidence: The same Appendix D retention rule defines the adversarial stimuli shown to humans. Human clean (image-condition) accuracy is reported and not used to filter trials; no clean-correct restriction is stated.

f1.evidence: Table Supp.2 gives ImageNet top-1 accuracy separately for all ten ensemble members and both held-out models; human image-condition accuracy is reported per group. These are full-validation (fine-class) accuracies, not accuracy on the coarse-class experimental images.

f2.evidence: Neither group states a target-clean-correct restriction or explicit inclusion; images were pre-filtered only for colour/brightness cues.

f3.evidence: Both groups use only adversarial images that fooled all 10 ensemble models (adv) or at least 7 of 10 (false). Positive conditioning evidence; the source is the generating ensemble.

f4.evidence: Machine rates are rounded percentages without stated numbers of retained images per group and condition; Appendix F lists image filenames but the retained adversarial set per condition is not given as counts. Table Supp.1 gives subject counts, not trial-level numerators.

f5.evidence: L-infinity perturbations fixed to exactly epsilon = 32 (adv) and 40 (false) on 0-255 pixels after rescaling images to [40, 215]; smaller perturbations are scaled up to epsilon.

f6.evidence: No code or adversarial images are linked. Several ensemble members are the authors' retina-layer models trained for this study, and no release of them was located; Appendix F lists the clean ImageNet image filenames only.

artifact_checks.result: Resolves to Google Drive file 1ns6LneQ-XMkgQWDy_usZ847RxOV-8304; downloaded the 47 MB full supplemental PDF (hash recorded). Contains figures and tables only, no data or code.
Repository search returned 0 results; no code link in the paper. Bounded search.

bounds_checks.reason: Rates are computed on source-successful retained images, the outcome is targeted coarse-class behaviour (humans, two-choice tasks), and no matched clean baseline on the experimental images is reported. Not substituted into the fixed-predictor misclassification identity.

limitations: Non-blind evidence audit. Table Supp.6 is captioned as 'error' while Table Supp.4 accuracies do not sum to 100% with it, suggesting success is targeted coarse-class success; recorded without resolving.
Including human observers as transfer targets is an applicability decision flagged for the independent recoder.
